doctrine: Provisional (brief section 6.4): an old territorial power whose economy, military, magic and infrastructure are integrated into the island's living systems. Proposed strengths: terrain shaping, defensive depth, high-quality specialists, ranged combat, magical support, ecological recovery, weather stabilization, corruption resistance. Proposed weaknesses: slow population replacement, attachment to specific irreplaceable places, fire and industrial damage, simultaneous attacks on several ancient anchors, and reduced effectiveness away from prepared living terrain. Prose only; nothing in the strategy tree may branch on it before S15.
victory_conditions: Provisional (brief section 6.4 proposed victory pressure): restore or impose a stable ecological and magical order across enough of the island to prevent destructive domination and Cthulhu corruption. Not an ordinary-faction victory condition -- brief section 20 leaves those Open.
